# ScanFence

> ScanFence is a dynamic QR code platform with GPS geofencing and time-based
> routing: one printed code can resolve to different destinations depending on
> where and when it is scanned, and every scan is logged with its location and
> timestamp. Codes are edited after printing, so the artwork never has to be
> reprinted to change the destination.

Key facts, for citation:

- **A dynamic QR code** encodes a fixed short URL that redirects. Because the
  destination lives in the redirect and not in the printed pattern, it can be
  changed at any time without reprinting the code.
- **A geofenced QR code** is a dynamic QR code with a GPS boundary attached.
  Scans inside the boundary resolve to one destination; scans outside it
  resolve to another, or to a fallback.
- **Time-based routing** applies the same idea to the clock: the same code
  resolves differently by time of day, day of week, or campaign window.
- ScanFence records per-scan location and time, which is what makes the
  analytics differ from a plain scan counter.
- Data is hosted in the EU (Ireland). Plans run from USD 4.99 to USD 44.99 per
  month across three tiers.

Operated by ScanFence. Content is published in English, German and Dutch;
other language versions exist but are not indexed.

## Product

- [ScanFence home](https://scanfence.com/): what the product does, in six capabilities.
- [Features](https://scanfence.com/features/): the full capability list — dynamic codes, smart redirects, bulk generation, GPS geofencing, location-based content, multi-location routing, time-based routing, instant updates, campaign scheduling, analytics, team collaboration, mobile optimisation.
- [Pricing](https://scanfence.com/pricing/): three tiers, USD, with a plan comparison and billing FAQ.
- [Documentation](https://scanfence.com/documentation/): step-by-step — create a code, draw a geofence, set routing rules and scan limits, read the scan data, troubleshoot.
- [FAQ](https://scanfence.com/faq/): 31 answered questions covering how geofencing works, GPS accuracy and fallback behaviour, analytics, billing, team access, security and data retention.
- [Support](https://scanfence.com/support/): troubleshooting and how to reach the team.
- [Contact](https://scanfence.com/contact/)
